name: room-viewer
description: The broker's room UI, embedded from internal/humanapi/ui/dist

scripts.build: rm -rf ../internal/humanapi/ui/dist && mkdir -p ../internal/humanapi/ui/dist/assets && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --minify --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=../internal/humanapi/ui/dist/assets/app.js && cp src/app.css ../internal/humanapi/ui/dist/assets/app.css && cp src/index.html ../internal/humanapi/ui/dist/ && cp -R src/assets/. ../internal/humanapi/ui/dist/assets/
